scenes.headline: How coupled oscillators can generate an image
scenes.sub: Un-0 swaps neural layers and a diffusion schedule for physics that settles.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Widget! Un-0, from Unconventional AI, makes images without a diffusion schedule. A field of coupled oscillators settles, and the pattern becomes a picture.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Let a physical system be the computation: couple thousands of oscillators, let them settle, and read the image off their phases.

scenes.title: The Kuramoto model
scenes.say: Each oscillator is a phase, turning around a dial.

parts.note: its own natural frequency, which is learned
parts.say: It turns at its own natural frequency.

parts.note: a pull toward the other oscillators' phases
parts.say: And it feels a pull toward the others' phases.

parts.note: coupling: weak scatters the phases, strong synchronizes them
parts.say: K is the coupling. Below a critical value the phases scatter; above it, the population locks into sync.

items.say: Start every oscillator at a random phase. That's the only randomness.

items.text: Class oscillators couple in, one way
items.say: A separate array of class oscillators couples in one way. The label bends the dynamics without being bent back.

items.text: Evolve the ODE once, to time T
items.say: Integrate the equation forward once, to a fixed time T. That's the whole generation.
Read the settled phases as sine and cosine, and a small decoder paints the pixels.

left.title: Diffusion model
items: Reverse a noising schedule, many passes
left.say: A diffusion model pushes tensors through learned layers, over and over.

right.title: Un-0
items: Integrate one coupled equation to time T
right.say: Un-0 lets a physical system relax, and training learns the physics itself: the coupling and the frequencies.

scenes.label: FID on ImageNet 64x64, with 16,384 oscillators and 322M parameters
scenes.note: self-reported, simulated on GPUs; behind state of the art
scenes.say: The largest run reaches an FID of six point seven four on ImageNet at sixty-four pixels. Modest, and simulated on GPUs: the analog chip isn't built yet.

scenes.text: Here the model is a dynamical system: training learns its physics, and letting it settle is the generation.
scenes.mark: letting it settle is the generation

recap: Kuramoto oscillators, coupled, with learned physics
Random phases, one-way class coupling, one ODE
A small decoder reads the settled phases
scenes.say: To recap: learn the coupling, let the field settle, and decode the phases.
